sources.title: AI and data centers are incredibly unpopular in every poll

cards.summary: Poll data released Tuesday by The New York Times and Siena University confirms what we've already been seeing , and what politicians are responding to - AI and data centers are incredibly unpopular. Asked if they support or oppose the construction of data centers to power AI tech, 61 percent of the 1,503 likely voters surveyed in early September (ahead of the recent AI safety slowdown discussion ) said they were opposed, with only 14 percent saying they strongly support.
